author: Astrokillah
text:
My broker has spread between 0.2 to 1 pip. Commission is $7 (round
turn) per lot so this effectively adds another 0.7 pips, essentially, if
 I make 2 pips I will be sure of making money. Just had a quick look,
the spreads are:

AUDUSD 0.3 pip

EURUSD 0.2 pip

GBPUSD 0.5 pip

USDCAD 0.6 pip

USDCHF 0.4 pip

EURJPY 0.6 pip

GBPJPY 0.9 pip

There is really no magic to my scalping. Price move from FL to FL, or
from Supply to Demand (vice versa). I read somewhere (I forgot where),
the best way to learn how to scalp is:

1) Open up 1-min chart

2) Use horizontal line only, draw lines at price levels where you think price will bounce

3) Watch as price hits your line, see how many times you got it right

4) The more you practice, the more accurate your prediction will be

A good place to start (in RTM) is perhaps the 'Finding The Decision" thread (under homework section).

author: Astrokillah
text:
Rule No. 1 - NO RED NEWS

Rule No. 2 - NO RED NEWS

Rule No. 3 - NO RED NEWS

Rule No. 4 - NO RED NEWS

ok, now we can talk about the rest of the rules. I don't use hard stop
when I scalp. I am watching charts, so I can react (in case of
catastrophic event). Because I don't have stop, so I am basically
'UNSTOPPABLE' !

It is important to do the exercise as I have explained in my previous
post. If you always get stopped out, watch what happened to price after
you got stopped out, do they reversed back to your entry? Or they
continue to go against you and you will bust your account if you don't
have stop.

You need to analyse your trades, you need hard statistic so you can improve on your success rate.
